name: John Sage Foundation annual grants
summary: Annual grants for Maine projects in ecological restoration, land conservation and stewardship, water quality and wildlife rehabilitation, with priority for smaller organisations. It also funds climate, education and research work.
reporting: An interim report is due six months into the project and a final report on completion.

calls.label: Annual round
calls.recurring: Applications are due each year by 30 April

status.quote: Applications Closed Please come back in 2027!

recurring.quote: All application materials must be received no later than April 30 for consideration at the Foundation's annual meeting in May.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include 501(c)(3) nonprofits, schools, government and tribal entities in Maine.

geography.quote: We only fund projects within the state of Maine.

access.quote: A complete application form found on the Apply Now page

window.quote: The Foundation operates a single annual cycle.

reporting.quote: Interim report: due six months into the project.
